bio.name: Nitin Kanzariya
paragraphs: I'm a passionate Full Stack Developer with over 2 years of professional experience specializing in building dynamic, responsive, and scalable web applications. With expertise spanning React.js, Next.js, Angular, Node.js, Python FastAPI, and .NET, I transform complex challenges into elegant, user-friendly solutions.

My unique blend of web development mastery and AI expertise allows me to create intelligent applications that leverage RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) chatbots, vector databases, and advanced AI models. I'm committed to continuous learning and staying updated with the latest industry trends, always pushing the boundaries of what's possible with technology.

items.description: Full-stack stock and trading management system with Microsoft Outlook integration for seamless email communication and automated workflows. Features dynamic email tagging, advanced mailing capabilities, responsive Angular dashboards for real-time insights, and optimized MySQL database schemas for financial transactions.

items.title: Connection AI
items.description: Pharma-related chat and PDF management platform with document upload, data extraction, and real-time updates. Features Redux Thunk for state management, seamless API integration, and optimized UI with Tailwind CSS for managing complex workflows in healthcare communications.

items.title: Photo Gallery
items.description: Cloud-based photo-sharing platform with Google OAuth authentication, following friends system, private/public uploads, and real-time chat. Features photo/video editing tools, Instagram-like engagement with likes and nested comments, advanced filtering, and Firebase storage with live updates.

items.title: Hospital Management System
items.description: Cross-platform healthcare app for patients and doctors with appointment scheduling, medical records management, and health reporting. Features secure Google Auth, real-time chat between patients and doctors, Firebase Cloud Firestore synchronization, and responsive Flutter UI for seamless cross-device experience.
